en: Regarding the single-seal method of Mārīcī, there are two seals:
first, the body seal; second, the invisibility seal.
First, perform the body seal at the heart and recite the mantra seven times to consecrate five places on the body. As for these five places, the first is—
The five locations are: first, the heart; second, the forehead; third, the left shoulder; fourth, the right shoulder; and fifth, the crown of the head.
As for the bodily mudrā, form hollow fists by joining the palms;
then, bend the tips of the two middle fingers and wrap them around the tips of the two index fingers.
This is the Great Vajracakra Mudrā. The mantra is:
Oṃ mārīcī svāhā. Next, perform the Invisibility Mudrā at the heart and recite it one hundred and eight times.
By the power of the empowerment of this seal and mantra,
no celestial Māras, evil spirits, unwholesome demons, or heterodox practitioners shall find an opportunity;
nor shall they be able to perceive the physical form of the practitioner.
Although they search exhaustively for the power of the heterodox,
they cannot find the physical form of the vidyādhara practitioner; therefore,
at each of the seven types of practice, [they fail].
One may perform consecration using seals and mantras during the seven types of activities;
the first is the time of sleep.
Second, at the time of awakening;
third, at the time of bathing;
fourth, at the time of traveling a long distance.
Fifth, when encountering guests;
sixth, when eating and drinking;
seventh, when going to the latrine.
Consecrate the five places with the body-mudrā.
Visualize that by means of the body-mudrā, one enters into the city of the adamantine, firm wisdom-fist.
This is the mudrā for invisibility.
Form an empty palm with the left hand;
clench the right hand into a fist and extend its five wheels (fingers) to cover the top of the clenched left hand, which is held as an empty palm.
Without allowing any interval between them,
[one should focus on] the mind and body.
The mantra is as follows:
Oṃ arthāma-le-svāhā. The single-seal dharma of Mārīcī.
